title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. This sketch consists of a closed loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin [0.0, 0.0] and ends at [0.03, 0.0]. The second line starts from [0.03, 0.0] and extends to [0.03, 0.03]. The third line runs from [0.03, 0.03] to [0.0, 0.03], and the fourth line completes the loop by connecting [0.0, 0.03] back to the origin. After drawing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.03 to the entire sketch. Ensure that the sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by setting the rotation angles to zero and the translation vector to zero. Finally, extrude the scaled sketch along its normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid body. This process results in a rectangular section with a length of 0.03 units, a width of 0.03 units, and a height of 0.75 units, which forms the top of a cylindrical object.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch with the specified lines
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.03, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.03, 0.03) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.03) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the final shape
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
